verdict.rationale: Formant documents real-time telemetry and status updates across the fleet, an Observe view, and a peer-to-peer WebRTC connection to deployed devices. It also offers commands to pull a file from the device or run a script on it, which together support remote state inspection and some debugging. Live ROS topic inspection is only implied through configurable data-stream ingestion, and log viewing is never explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit live ROS topic browsing/echo, a documented remote log viewing or streaming feature, hands-on or independent corroboration of remote debugging workflows.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can inspect live topics, logs, and state on a deployed robot remotely to debug issues

citations.quote: Real-time telemetry and status updates across your entire fleet.
